breakdown.reason: The generated specification changed the upstream Mach number from 0.8 (subsonic) to 2.0 (supersonic), correctly recognizing that normal shock waves only form in supersonic flow, matching the ground truth.

breakdown.description: Second law of thermodynamics prohibits expansion shocks (subsonic to supersonic transitions via shock)
